image_title: Comparison of Improvement Metrics for Math Levels
summary: This bar chart compares the improvement percentages across different math levels (MATH-L1 to MATH-L5) for two methods: TTRL and T³RL. The y-axis represents the percentage of improvement, while the x-axis lists the math levels. MATH-L1 shows the highest improvement at over 250%, followed by MATH-L2 with a modest increase of 0.5%. The T³RL method demonstrates a consistent upward trend in additional gain, peaking at 8.9% for MATH-L5. Overall, the chart highlights the effectiveness of the T³RL method in achieving higher improvements across the math levels compared to TTRL.
